summary: Redact quoted credentials and Basic authorization in developer support exports.
details: The diagnostic converter and both private-value validators share one credential grammar. Quoted token, access-token, secret, password and API-key values are consumed whole, including spaces and escaped quotes; Basic headers join existing Bearer handling.
Quoted replacements remain quoted, the exact placeholder is stable on repeated conversion, and a private suffix after the placeholder is rejected. The input record is preserved.

The consumed A14 exporter test passes 75 new synthetic assertions and its existing bundle, schema, minimization and rejection controls. Candidate-bound export and standalone startup-crash collection retain separate qualification requirements.
